top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is a mature, independently confirmed arc from proglucagon processing and the active truncated peptide, through human incretin physiology and receptor biology, to therapies with large randomized outcome trials. A Physiology or Medicine citation is best anchored on discrete, citable discoveries of the hormone's biology and active form, so Drucker, Holst and Mojsov (P001) fit better than a configuration that credits drug design. P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is a defensible fallback if the peptide-priority record is judged unusable, and any award is preferable to no award given the maturity and impact of this work.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for the GLP-1 laureates; my profile records co-authorship with Rickard Sandberg and others, but none with the proposed laureates.
